changes.title: Women Straight Fit Denim
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
Step out in style with these women’s flared denim jeans. Crafted from durable, high-quality denim, they offer a flattering fit and classic flare, perfect for casual outings, chic everyday wear, and versatile pairing with tops or jackets.

Care Instructions:
o Machine or hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
o Gentle cycle
o Do not dry in direct sunlight
o Do not bleach
o Do not iron directly on prints/embroidery
changes.after:
Step out in style with these women’s Straight Fit denim jeans. Crafted from durable, high-quality denim, they offer a Straight fit, perfect for casual outings, chic everyday wear, and versatile pairing with tops or jackets.

Care Instructions:
o Machine or hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
o Gentle cycle
o Do not dry in direct sunlight
o Do not bleach
o Do not iron directly on prints/embroidery
